data.narrative:
First Resonance is a Series A robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $40.8M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of nine private companies and one public company (ticker: 277810.KQ) spanning the robotics and manufacturing sector at seed through Series B stages.

Two triangulation methods apply to this target. Stage-progression analysis uses the $41M total raised as a proxy for current valuation and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A to subsequent-stage progression, yielding $82M. Peer-median analysis samples five same-sector and same/adjacent-stage comparables—Generalist AI ($2.0B Series B), Bedrock Robotics ($1.8B Series B), Dexterity ($1.6B Series B), Humanoid ($1.4B Series A), and Walden Robotics ($1.1B Seed)—producing a median valuation of $1.6B with a range of $1.1B to $2.0B.

The two methods produce a wide triangulated range: $69M (low), $866M (median), and $1.9B (high). The median of $866M reflects tension between the conservative stage-progression result and the substantially higher peer-median multiple. Key uncertainties include whether peer valuations appropriately reflect First Resonance's capital efficiency, market traction, and technical differentiation relative to the Series B comparables. The wide range suggests additional diligence on unit economics and path to Series B financing is warranted before narrowing the valuation window.
